بُلَلَةٌ and its pl.: see three exs. voce بَلَلٌ ―
-b2- The sing. also signifies Garb, guise, aspect or appearance, external state or condition. (Ibn- 'Abbád, K.) You say, إِنَّهُ لَحَسَنُ البُلَلَةِ Verily he is goodly, or beautiful, in garb, &c. (Ibn- 'Abbád, TA.) ―
-b3- You say also, كَيْفَ بُلَلَتُكَ, and ↓ بُلُولَتُكَ , meaning How is thy state, or condition? (Ibn-'Abbád, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
